name: If You Stay
source:
Two girls, Mika and Yara, realizing they’ve been outed by their school teacher to their parents and friends, spend their “final date” reconciling through the pain of hiding in the closet while navigating adolescence. Decide for them if they should run away together or ultimately split up.

[from [url=https://yukimisoft.itch.io/if-you-stay-2023]itch.io[/url]]
